title: The Address Did Not Exist. He Walked Nine Hours Anyway. #Shorts
description:
Deliver it by hand. Deliver it to the person named and to nobody else. Do not use the tram.

The third instruction was the one that mattered, and nobody explained it to him. He was fifteen, and the address he had been given did not exist.
